title: Avatar Group
description: Wrap multiple Avatars within an AvatarGroup to stack them.
summary: A wrapper for stacking multiple Avatar components with overlap styling.
shortDescription: Avatar Group wraps multiple Avatar components and displays them in an overlapping stack arrangement. It handles proper z-index layering so earlier avatars appear behind later ones, and optionally shows a count indicator when the number of avatars exceeds a configured maximum. Commonly used to display team members, participants, or contributors in a compact space-efficient format.
